No `baseUrl`: TypeScript 6 reports it as deprecated (TS5101) and drops it
in 7.0. Removing it is why every path below starts with `./` — without a
baseUrl, TypeScript rejects bare paths (TS5090) and resolves relative ones
against this file's own directory. The two go together; changing one
without the other trades one error for another.
